meta.title: Counter offer while bidding is live: the vendor rejects
gaps: The prepared state contains only one bid, so the RFQ with two bids (Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90) and any two-vendor comparison cannot be asserted.
There is no catalog assertion for a counter offer's rejected status or rejection history; the vendor rejection is checked through the portal action and success toast instead.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The prepared state contains only one bid, so the RFQ with two bids (Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90) and any two-vendor comparison cannot be asserted.; There is no catalog assertion for a counter offer's rejected status or rejection history; the vendor rejection is checked through the portal action and success toast instead.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen without searching the events list.
Send a counter offer on the prepared vendor's normal bid, changing the counter price to 90.
Verify that the buyer's counter offer was initiated.
Move to the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer is available.
Verify that the vendor can see the pending counter offer before rejecting it.
Reject the pending counter offer as the vendor.
Verify the vendor portal reports successful rejection.
Verify the vendor view still shows the original bid price of 100 after rejection.
Return to the buyer's Responses screen.
Open the buyer's Master QCS to inspect the retained bid price.
Verify the original vendor bid remains 100 in Master QCS.
Verify the buyer can send a new counter offer after the vendor rejected the first one while bidding remains live.
Verify the new counter offer was initiated.
